statement.zh: 基什及其腹地可由菲尔德博物馆—牛津记录与区域调查重建，见 Gibson《基什城及地区》（1972）。
statement.en: Kish and its hinterland can be reconstructed from Field Museum–Oxford records and area survey, as synthesized in Gibson The City and Area of Kish (1972).
